verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS lists teleoperation packages, and GR00T uses teleoperation to capture demonstrations. Neither documents routing autonomy failures to a human intervention queue, an operator resolving the issue, or a handback of control to autonomy. Generic teleoperation is an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can route autonomy failures to a human intervention queue where an operator resolves and hands back control

citations.quote: Deploy perception, localization, mapping, manipulation, teleoperation, and AI inference using production-ready ROS packages optimized for NVIDIA platforms.
